extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create a new Wikipedia article (new or prospective Wikipedia editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or locating a Wikipedia article with a given title (e.g., troubleshooting why a page does not exist and what to do). Applicable to editors checking existence, creation permissions, and deletion status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Matt Rife special 2023' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.

rubrics_metrics.name: If page was recently created, wait or purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log if page deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion reasons in the log to understand deletion rationale and whether recreation is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to this title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' to find incoming links which may reveal alternate titles or indicate prior use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot create the page directly, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are procedural alternatives for contributors who cannot immediately create a live article (e.g., because of account restrictions or notability concerns).
